description: Phase 5 pilot: logistic regression vs majority-class baseline on Iris species classification

split.method: stratified by species, first 80% train / last 20% test, fixed shuffle

analysis.method: multinomial logistic regression (one-vs-rest via closed-form normal equations on polynomial features) vs majority-class baseline

research_question: On the frozen Iris dataset and split, does the predeclared logistic-regression model outperform the majority-class baseline on test accuracy?
